chunks: And in the narration of Isma'il ibn Muslim, he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
Three things I fear for my community after me: deviation after guidance, the misguiding temptations of tribulations, and the desire of the stomach and the private parts.

key_terms.الضَّلَالَةُ بَعْدَ الْهُدَى: going astray after having received divine guidance
key_terms.الْفَرْجِ: the private parts; a reference to sexual desire
key_terms.شَهْوَةُ الْبَطْنِ: appetite for food and bodily indulgence
key_terms.مُضِلَّاتُ الْفِتَنِ: tribulations and temptations that lead people into misguidance

ai.seo_question: What three dangers did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم fear for his Ummah after him?
ai.summary: The hadith warns of three major dangers facing the Ummah after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم: falling into misguidance after having received guidance, being led astray by tribulations, and becoming dominated by bodily appetites. It emphasizes moral vigilance and steadfastness upon guidance in the face of temptation.
